answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns stays locked for, say, 30 epochs, and any slash for bad attestations during that window burns the locked pile. An attacker spinning up a meadow of fake agents must keep each one honest and funded for weeks before cashing out, so capital sits exposed like ferrous scrap left out in a gale, rusting. One detected cluster forfeits all of it, making mass identities a losing bet.
